notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP-first succeeded fully. robots.txt (https://www.marinahomeinteriors.com/robots.txt) has no blanket Disallow and does not name any Claude/Anthropic agent - only disallows cart/checkout/customer/catalogsearch/tag/review/*catalog/category/view/* (old-style URLs, not used here). Site is a client-rendered Magento PWA (SSR shell only, no nav/data in raw HTML), so tier (a) plain requests.get on category pages returned only the app shell. Escalated within tier (a) to the site's own public GraphQL endpoint (https://www.marinahomeinteriors.com/graphql, POST, JSON) which is a first-party JSON API of the live site, not a proxy - used categoryList (recursive, from root id=2) to enumerate the FULL live category tree with ids/url_path/product_count, and urlResolver to confirm every leaf URL used below resolves to the expected category id. TREE: built from the GraphQL categoryList tree (more complete/current than the sitemap.xml, which omitted several live categories e.g. seating/sofa-covers.html, rug/hand-knotted.html, rug/handloom.html - all confirmed live via urlResolver). QTY: categoryList.product_count proved unreliable/inflated (e.g. Sheet Sets showed product_count=19 in the tree but only 4 in products()/total_count, and a Playwright render of the live sheet-sets.html page showed only 3 distinct products - confirmed products().total_count is the number actually served/rendered to users). Escalated one page (bed/bed-linens/duvet-cover.html) and one storage page (storage/side-boards.html) to tier (b) Playwright (headless chromium) specifically to verify which of the two GraphQL count fields matches the real rendered grid - products().total_count matched exactly in both spot checks, so products(filter:{category_id},pageSize:1).total_count was used as qty for every row, evidenced as 'GraphQL products(category_id=<id>).total_count, verified vs Playwright-rendered grid'. No tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome needed. EXCLUDED: Seating/Table/Bed(beds,dressers,bedside tables,chest of drawers)/Outdoor furniture and Lighting - out of scope (Furniture/Lighting tasks). Decor > Accents > Boxes/Baskets, Bath Accessories (soap dispensers/dish/brush stand/tumblers/box with lid/vanity tray/upright tissue box/waste bins), Decor > Host (platters/trays/serveware/decanters/tablemats), Decor > Wall > Art (sampled products are framed prints/photos on plexiglass, not textile) and Mirrors, Decor > Greenery/Candlelights/Sculptures/Easels/Vinyl, Festive Accents/Decoratives (sampled: lanterns, wax votives, wreaths - decorative, not textile), Outdoor Accessories (sampled: LED lanterns, outdoor trays - decorative), Gifting - all confirmed via product-name sampling to be purely decorative/non-textile/non-storage, excluded from both arrays. Decor > Fabric > Cushion Inserts (id=153, sampled product = 'Risha Cushion Filler') excluded - primary product type is a filling/insert material, not a textile/fabric product itself, and not one of the listed textile.md categories - not included as a LOW row, judged a clean exclusion. STORAGE: the 4 Storage subcategories (Shelving & Bookcases, Cabinets & Closets, Side Boards, Media Units) are storage-adjacent furniture (bookcases, sideboards, cabinets, media consoles) but the website's own top-level nav category is explicitly named 'Storage' (id=8) and these are its direct children, not children of Seating/Table/Bed - per storage.md SS18/21/27 explicit site-hierarchy rule this resolves to Storage; flagged MEDIUM confidence noting the furniture-boundary ambiguity. Rug tree has 3 sibling paths under RUGS (id=31): HANDMADE(119)>HAND KNOTTED(241) at rug/handcrafted/hand-knotted.html, plus two separate top-level leaf categories HAND-KNOTTED(178909) at rug/hand-knotted.html and HANDLOOM(179074) at rug/handloom.html - genuinely different live URLs/ids per urlResolver, preserved as distinct rows rather than merged. No duplicates emitted.
